selectionQuestion: Which already-configured reasoner provider can serve the fixed W12 protocol within the declared bounded probe contract?
orderingCriteria: availability in the existing configured CLI model registry
compatibility with the production print adapter and typed turn protocol
sufficient context for bounded current-source requests

probe.retryPolicy: no-retry; each candidate receives at most one bounded probe
successRequires: response contains a valid bounded TERMINATE intent
response bytes are greater than zero

candidates.reason: retained subscribed-family compatibility and context fit from the predecessor, without using W12 quality
predeclared subscribed-family compatibility and context fit
predeclared subscribed-family compatibility and context fit
predeclared subscribed-family compatibility and context fit
predeclared configured fallback namespace for protocol availability only

classification.ABSENT: provider is not present in the live CLI registry before invocation
classification.PROVIDER_PROBE_TIMEOUT: probe exceeds timeoutMs without a valid response
classification.PROVIDER_NONZERO_EXIT: CLI exits non-zero before a valid response
classification.PROVIDER_INVALID_RESPONSE: CLI exits zero but output is not a valid typed response
classification.UNAVAILABLE: any non-success probe classification; it is not a valid W12 result

firstPassingCandidateRule: freeze the first candidate in ordinal order classified VALID_PROVIDER_RUN; do not probe later candidates
allCandidatesFailRule: record every declared probe outcome and stop W12 before investigation as PARTIAL — BLOCKED; never report zero yield
postFreezeRule: after the first valid W12 investigative result, provider identity, model, probe policy, and CLI configuration are immutable for this wave
preResultFailureRule: if the selected provider fails before any valid W12 investigative result, a transition is allowed only by owner decision under a regenerated complete W12 freeze before investigation; no transition is performed implicitly
